newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WEEK AHEAD-Australian market focus swings back to domestic rates.
newsitem.headline: WEEK AHEAD-Australian market focus swings back to domestic rates.

text.p: Australian markets are seen shifting their focus this week away from the gyrations on Wall Street and back to the local inflation outlook and the bullish prospect of another official rate cut.
Australian stocks and bonds rallied late last week on the growing conviction that the Dow had settled and as hopes of another domestic monetary policy easing grew.

The announcement at 2.00 p.m. (0400 GMT) on Tuesday of the Australian Industrial Relation Commission's (AIRC) decision on the "Living Wage" and March quarter inflation data on Wednesday are seen either opening or closing the door to another rate cut
